meta.description: How to build a production design system using custom properties, @layer, and custom elements — no Sass, no Tailwind, no build step.

Modern CSS has native features that replace every layer of the traditional design system toolchain: custom properties for tokens,
for module loading, and custom elements for component encapsulation.

Because everything references tokens, theming is just swapping custom property values. A
attribute selector overrides the token layer:
One attribute, entire site transforms. No class swapping, no JavaScript theme providers, no CSS-in-JS runtime. The cascade does all the work.

Vanilla Breeze ships ~50 themes out of the box — from color accents like Ocean and Forest to dramatic personality themes like Brutalist, Terminal, Vaporwave, and Catppuccin. All built on the same token override pattern.
